title: Merge K Sorted Lists
statement: You are given a list of k linked lists, each represented as a plain list of integers sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked lists into one sorted list (represented as a plain list of integers) and return it.
hints: Use a min-heap that holds one 'next candidate' element from each of the k lists at a time.
Seed the heap with the first element of every non-empty list, tagging each entry with which list and index it came from to break ties and to know what to push next.
Repeatedly pop the smallest, append it to the result, and push the next element from the same source list, until the heap is empty.
